name: RTEB v1 — Translation-Entropy Routing Benchmark item bank
registration: RTEB v1 Protocol (registered 2026-07-29, thresholds frozen before any scoring run)
grade: developer-benchmark / corroboration — items authored with knowledge of the lexical cue lists; stratum A is cue-bearing by construction

strata.B: clear intent, paraphrase/OOV — zero lexical cue hits across all hypotheses, enforced by construction QA in the runner
strata.C: genuinely ambiguous — truth is a set of >= 2 plausible intents; correct routing behavior is to ask
